samples.summary: Hardcoded font list duplicates the existing single-source-of-truth font catalog and will drift from it
samples.evidence: `VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES` / `VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS` are hand-maintained in the harness script, but the app already has an authoritative registry: `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts` (`FONT_CATALOG`, `buildGoogleFontsHref()`, per-entry `weights`, `eager` flag), documented as the "Single source of truth for the shared font-family picker". The bootstrap link the harness must wait on is literally `FONT_CATALOG.filter(f => f.webFont && f.eager)` plus the three families in `packages/frontend/index.html:12`. Enumerating them a third time by hand is exactly the drift that this PR is fixing — the next catalog regeneration (`scripts/build-font-catalog.mjs`) silently re-opens the same bug class. Deriving the list (or at minimum asserting it against the catalog in a test) fits the repo's reuse expectation better.

samples.summary: The new family list is still incomplete against its own stated rule — 4 of the 8 eager catalog families are missing
samples.evidence: The comment states "The list must include the families the *app itself* pulls from fonts.googleapis.com", but `FONT_CATALOG_DATA` marks eight entries `eager: true` (Noto Sans KR, Noto Serif KR, Nanum Gothic, Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum, Gowun Batang, Roboto — font-catalog.data.ts lines 6-9,13-15,49). The diff adds Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono from index.html but still omits Nanum Myeongjo, Gothic A1, Gowun Dodum and Gowun Batang, all of which the bootstrap `ensureGoogleFontsLink()` request fetches over the network. Any baseline that paints those families remains subject to the same swap race the PR claims to close (the catch-all `status !== "loading"` poll only covers faces already requested, not ones a paint has not yet triggered).

samples.summary: Hand-picked weight matrix conflicts with the weights the app actually requests
samples.evidence: `VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS = [400, 500, 600, 700]` is applied uniformly, but the catalog requests `400;700` for every eager family and index.html requests Fraunces at `500;600;700` (no 400) and JetBrains Mono at `400;500` only. The harness therefore loads/checks weights that are never fetched for most families, relying on CSS font-matching fallback to make `check()` pass. Per-family weights already exist on `FontEntry.weights`; using them would express the intent precisely instead of a global superset.

samples.summary: Four stacked wait strategies where the catch-all largely subsumes the enumerated ones
samples.evidence: The added `[...document.fonts].every(face => face.status !== "loading")` poll, per its own comment, is a catch-all for families "nobody thought to list here". Combined with two load passes, a networkidle, and an enumerated check poll, the routine now has four layers whose interaction is hard to reason about and whose failure mode (a bare 10s timeout with no family named) is opaque. Worth considering whether the catch-all plus a much smaller enumerated floor achieves the same determinism with less machinery.

samples.summary: Visual-lane font determinism policy is described in harness-engineering.md but not updated for the new wait ordering
samples.evidence: `docs/design/harness-engineering.md` is the canonical doc for the visual/browser lane (Docker font pinning, baseline policy, `verify-visual-browser.mjs`). This change alters when fonts are settled relative to section mount and which families are considered load-bearing for baseline stability. Not an architecture/data-model change, so no new doc is required, but a line in the existing canonical doc would keep the harness contract discoverable.

verdict.reason: All cited evidence checks out against the repository. verify-visual-browser.mjs:346-362 does hand-maintain VISUAL_FONT_FAMILIES (7 families) and VISUAL_FONT_WEIGHTS. font-catalog.ts:1-3 self-documents as the "Single source of truth for the shared font-family picker", and buildGoogleFontsHref() at :111-115 is exactly FONT_CATALOG.filter(f => f.webFont && f.eager) with per-entry weights (:47) and eager (:63). index.html:12 contains precisely the three families (Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono) the harness re-lists. The duplication is in-lane for the design-fit reviewer (duplication/reuse) and is not merely theoretical: the catalog has 8 eager:true entries (font-catalog.data.ts:6-9,13-15,49) while the harness lists only 4 of them, so the hand-list has already drifted from the registry. A Node-side EAGER set also already exists in build-font-catalog.mjs:41-44, and build-font-files.mjs:30 shows .mjs-to-.mjs import of that module is an established pattern here, so derivation is feasible. The catch-all "no FontFace in status loading" poll (verify-visual-browser.mjs:394-396) is a partial backstop the file itself calls "a floor, not the whole truth" — not a guard that makes the duplication unreachable. The originating task doc (docs/tasks/active/20260811-visual-inter-font-race-todo.md:44-45) does prescribe adding to the hardcoded list, which is the strongest counterargument, but an intended approach does not neutralize a duplication-of-single-source-of-truth fit violation. No named refutation ground holds.
